mandate: C315 — test the MOMENTUM / SHORT-TERM REVERSAL statistical-arbitrage family on 10 USDT-M linear perps at native 5m (3456 pre-registered configs). Signals: xsec_mom (trailing-L cross-sectional momentum), xsec_rev (trailing-R reversal), mom_minus_rev (combined). Single-leg dollar-neutral perp PnL with costs charged on turnover (symmetric and perp_heavy variants). Gates: Holm+BH at alpha=0.05 (BOTH), MDE, stability, and momentum-vs-reversal-vs-placebo attribution.

methodology.signal: trailing simple returns mom_L=c[t]/c[t-L]-1, rev_R=c[t]/c[t-R]-1; xsec_mom=+mom_L; xsec_rev=-rev_R; mom_minus_rev=z(mom_L)-z(rev_R); causal shift(1).
methodology.pnl: single-leg perp: pnl = sum_i pos_i * perp_ret_i (pos>0 long).
methodology.costs: charged on turnover; symmetric = fee+slip; perp_heavy = 1.5*fee+slip.
methodology.multiple_testing: one-sided paired t-test of per-split OOS net vs flat (0); Holm step-down AND Benjamini-Hochberg over all 3456 configs at alpha=0.05.
methodology.attribution: reference config vs xsec_rev vs placebo (per-asset randomly permuted perp returns); shares = |net| / sum(|mom|,|rev|,|placebo|).
methodology.stability: sign consistency >= 0.70 of splits AND first/second-half Sharpe corr >= 0.5.
methodology.funding: USDT-M funding unreachable (fapi 451, not in archives) -> excluded (control only).
